name: U26-preview-retry
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');const h=window.__sim.host;await h.work.pictures();const m=structuredClone(h.journal.findLast(e=>e.event.type==='timeline_appended'&&e.event.task_id===workIds.receipt&&e.event.item.item.kind==='user_message'&&e.event.item.item.bundle).event.item);m.seq=h.seq+1;m.item.text='Only change spacing in Today. Do not edit typography or the Next card.';m.item.delivery='failed';const b=m.item.bundle;b.sources.forEach(s=>s.origin={kind:'preview_capture',capture_id:'u26-picture',host_id:ids.host,computer_name:'studio',preview_id:'sim-preview-unknown',preview_label:'Notes',captured_at:s.captured_at});localStorage.setItem('u26-message',JSON.stringify(m));localStorage.setItem('preview-deliveries.sim-studio',JSON.stringify({'u26-picture':{taskId:workIds.receipt,taskTitle:'Tighten checkout layout',at:m.at,bundleId:b.bundle_id,revision:b.revision,messageSeq:m.seq,state:'failed',request:m.item}}));const {previewDrafts}=await import('/src/screens/control/previewDrafts.ts');const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=390;canvas.height=260;const c=canvas.getContext('2d');c.fillStyle='#eeeeff';c.fillRect(0,0,390,260);c.fillStyle='#222';c.font='24px sans-serif';c.fillText('Today',24,60);c.fillText('Next card',24,180);const blob=await new Promise(r=>canvas.toBlob(r));await previewDrafts.put({id:'u26-picture',profileId:'sim-studio',previewId:'sim-preview-unknown',previewLabel:'Notes',computerId:ids.host,computerName:'studio',projectId:ids.pTide,taskId:workIds.receipt,at:m.at,blob,artifactId:b.sources[0].artifact_id});const {annotationStore}=await import('/src/state/annotations.ts');const store=annotationStore('sim-studio');const a=store.create(ids.pTide,workIds.receipt);store.update(a.id,d=>({...d,sources:b.sources.map(s=>({key:s.key,blobKey:null,artifactId:s.artifact_id,sha256:s.sha256,mediaType:s.media_type,width:s.width,height:s.height,durationMs:null,origin:s.origin,capturedAt:s.captured_at,derivedFrom:null,derivation:null})),marks:b.marks,comments:b.comments}));const {previewDeliveries}=await import('/src/screens/control/previewDelivery.ts');previewDeliveries('sim-studio').set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('preview-deliveries.sim-studio')));h.emit({type:'timeline_appended',task_id:workIds.receipt,item:m});})()
const value=document.querySelector('.composer textarea')?.value;if(value!=='Only change spacing in Today. Do not edit typography or the Next card.')throw Error('Retry lost text');

name: U26-ask-light
steps: (async()=>{const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const h=window.__sim.host;const task=h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===ids.tFlaky);task.state='working';task.mode='ask';task.status_line='Checking the spacing';h.emit({type:'task_upserted',task});const run=h.runs.find(r=>r.run_id===task.current_run);run.state='working';h.emit({type:'run_upserted',run});for(const a of h.approvals){a.state='resolved_elsewhere';h.emit({type:'approval_upserted',approval:a})}h.emit({type:'timeline_appended',task_id:task.task_id,item:{seq:h.seq+1,at:Date.now(),run_id:run.run_id,item:{kind:'agent_message',text:'I found the Today card. Its spacing is independent of typography and the Next card. I am checking the layout.',partial:false}}});})()

Its spacing is independent of typography and the Next card. I am checking the layout.',partial:false}}});})()

name: U26-queue-two-projects
steps: (async()=>{const {ids}=await import("/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts");const h=window.__sim.host;for(const a of h.attention){a.resolved_at=Date.now();h.emit({type:'attention_resolved',attention_id:a.attention_id})}for(const pid of [ids.pTide,ids.pNotes]){const project=h.projects.find(p=>p.project_id===pid);project.active_writer=null;h.emit({type:'project_upserted',project});const task={...h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===ids.tReadme),task_id:crypto.randomUUID(),project_id:pid,title:pid===ids.pTide?'Review the API docs':'Review Today spacing',state:'accepted',attention_count:0};h.tasks.push(task);h.emit({type:'task_upserted',task});const q=h.talk.queue(pid);q.items=[];q.paused=false;q.writer=null;h.talk.put(q);h.talk.enqueue(task,task.title,null,{mode:'queue',position:null,authorization:'ask_before_start'});}})()

if(window.__sim.host.attention.filter(a=>a.resolved_at===null).length!==2)throw Error('Expected two go-aheads');if(document.querySelector('.nav__count').textContent!=='2')throw Error('Work badge disagrees');if(!document.querySelector('.work-screen').textContent.includes('1 in field-notes'))throw Error('Other project badge missing');

if(!document.querySelector('.queue-review')){const text=document.querySelector('.tab:not(.is-hidden)').textContent;if(!text.includes('Review the API docs')||!text.includes('Start'))throw Error('Wrong queue review')}

name: U26-slow-send
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');ui.selectProject(ids.pGarden);ui.saveDraft(ids.pGarden,null,{text:"Check the garden spacing",mode:"ask"});ui.reset("control",[{screen:"review",projectId:ids.pGarden,taskId:null,intent:"new_task"}]);ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

name: U26-slow-message
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');const {annotationStore}=await import('/src/state/annotations.ts');const store=annotationStore('sim-studio');const a=store.create(ids.pTide,ids.tDash);store.update(a.id,d=>({...d,generalNote:'Only spacing'}));ui.selectTask(ids.pTide,ids.tDash);ui.saveDraft(ids.pTide,ids.tDash,{text:'Keep the typography',annotationId:a.id});ui.reset('control',[{screen:'annotate',annotationId:a.id},{screen:'review',projectId:ids.pTide,taskId:ids.tDash,intent:'next_turn'}]);ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

name: U26-blocked-continue
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {workIds}=await import('/src/dev/sim/work.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');ui.selectTask(ids.pTide,ids.tHeaders);ui.saveDraft(ids.pTide,ids.tHeaders,{text:"Check the spacing once more"});ui.reset("talk");ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

const blocker=document.querySelector('.composer__blocker').getBoundingClientRect();const button=document.querySelector('.composer__send').getBoundingClientRect();const frame=document.querySelector('.talk').getBoundingClientRect();if(blocker.top<frame.top||button.bottom>frame.bottom||blocker.bottom>button.top)throw Error('Blocker and Continue are not visible together');if(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.composer')).overflowY==='auto')throw Error('Composer still scrolls inside');
